title: Preview validated sheet-layout geometry
description: Render an explanatory persisted preview of the sheet, independent margins, gaps, rows, columns, and square or rounded label boundaries directly from validated normalized geometry.
acceptanceCriteria: The preview sheet aspect ratio matches normalized sheet width and height
Every label boundary is positioned from margins, gaps, row, column, label width, and label height
Known and estimated radii render rounded boundaries; zero renders square boundaries; unknown is visibly disclosed without inventing a radius
The preview is derived only from validated normalized geometry
A textual summary exposes row count, column count, dimensions, margins, gaps, and radius state
The same persisted revision renders equivalently after reload

steps.details: Create a pure mapping from validated geometry to sheet bounds, label boundary rectangles, margin guides, gap guides, and radius disclosure in millimetre coordinates.
Use one SVG viewBox matching sheet dimensions and render guides and boundaries without recalculating domain geometry from viewport pixels.
Provide adjacent semantic text for dimensions, counts, each margin, gaps, and radius state so the preview is not an input-only or inaccessible canvas.
Load the selected exact revision, validate it, and render its preview; show an actionable error rather than partial geometry when decoding fails.
Assert SVG boundary coordinates against a known fixture and reload the browser to confirm the same persisted revision and textual summary return.

technicalNotes: Preview scale is presentation-only and must not mutate millimetre geometry.
Unknown corner radius must not be drawn as if known; pair any fallback visualization with explicit disclosure.
